title: Rosemary Beach: Summer Breeze Flat in Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: Summer Breeze Flat in Rosemary Beach.
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Experience the epitome of contemporary comfort in this meticulously updated 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence, strategically positioned to embrace the beauty of St. Augustine Green. With thoughtfully curated furnishings and a prime location, this home is a harmonious blend of style and convenience. Step into a space where modern design meets comfort. Every corner of this home has been adorned with carefully chosen, updated furnishings, creating an atmosphere of sophistication and relaxation. The spacious master bedroom is a retreat unto itself, featuring a Queen-sized bed. With ample storage and an ensuite bathroom, this sanctuary provides the perfect blend of comfort and functionality. The guest bedroom is designed with flexibility in mind, offering a comfortable queen-sized bed and a set of bunk beds. Ideal for accommodating family, friends, or creating a cozy haven for little ones. The living area is an inviting space, seamlessly connecting the living room, dining area, and kitchen. Natural light pours in through large windows, accentuating the warmth and openness of the home.

This home requires a 4 night stay during peak season and 2 night stay during the shoulder season.
